locus: §4 intro — “Two instruments, run separately, carry the results.”
current:
Two instruments, run separately, carry the results. *Pangram* is a
commercial AI-text detector, scored segment by segment and calibrated
against each chamber's own pre-2022 record; it answers the prevalence
question. The *register instrument* is a fixed list of machine-overused
vocabulary — Kobak's excess-vocabulary style words — counted against each
chamber's own placebo-matched counterfactual; it is detector-independent,
transparent, and cheap enough to run across three decades, and it carries
the historical and social results. Construction, calibration and estimators
are specified in Materials and Methods; every number reproduces from a
committed script.
proposed:
Two instruments carry distinct parts of the analysis. *Pangram* is a
commercial AI-text detector, scored segment by segment and calibrated
against each chamber's own pre-2022 record; it estimates current prevalence.
The *register instrument* counts a fixed list of machine-overused vocabulary
— Kobak's excess-vocabulary style words — against each chamber's own
placebo-matched counterfactual. Because it is detector-independent,
transparent and cheap enough to run across three decades, it carries the
historical and social analyses. Materials and Methods specifies both
instruments, their calibration and the estimators; committed scripts
reproduce every reported number.
rationale: This version states the division of labor between the instruments immediately and replaces the vague phrase “carries the results” with the questions each instrument answers. It preserves the reproducibility statement without making it the paragraph's emphasis.
